GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone

GPT-6 with Intelligent UI starts rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers today in the Chat tab.

GPT-6 in ChatGPT is powered by GPT-6 Sol for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers, and GPT-6 Luna for Free and Go tiers.

The Pro reasoning option uses GPT-6 Astra. The models powering Work and Codex are not changing as part of this release.
